Each graph records the exact reading ID, upstream projection and normalized-context identities, ordered reading goal IDs, one root obligation per goal in the same order, a deterministic preorder obligation sequence, complete local contexts, child and prerequisite edges, explicit unsupported and choice-required indexes, the frozen catalogue identities, and mathematical_authority false.

Prove-mode truth and relation statements remain exact atomic obligations; negation remains an exact undecomposed negation obligation; conjunction emits all ordered operands; disjunction emits all ordered explicit alternatives and a choice_required parent; implication adds only its exact antecedent statement as a local hypothesis for the consequent; biconditional emits both ordered implication directions.

Universal statements extend the local binder context in declared variable order and expose the body; existential statements expose symbolic witness-construction and body-verification duties; exists_unique statements additionally expose an exact uniqueness duty bound to the original statement without synthesizing a new logical formula.

Refute, find_witness, compute, classify, and optimize goal modes remain exact single mode-shaped obligations and are never rewritten into prove goals, negated, evaluated, searched, classified, optimized, or otherwise executed by this boundary.

Every obligation records one stable ID and ordinal, root goal and parent, reviewed rule, exact kind and goal mode, structurally derived ready, waiting, choice_required, or unsupported status, exact statement and relation references where present, complete canonical statement or component fragment identity, source spans, typed semantic dependency closure, local-context identity, ordered children and prerequisites, alternatives, symbolic witness placeholders, exact strategy-admissibility records, payload, support state, and mathematical_authority false.

Each local context binds the exact reading and normalized context, all reading definition IDs in declared order, all normalized assumption-fact identities in context order, inherited bound variables, exact local hypothesis statements, symbolic witness placeholders, typed semantic dependency closure, complete reachable source spans, and mathematical_authority false.

Structural status is derived only from graph shape: unsupported nodes are unsupported, disjunction parents are choice_required, parents with unresolved child duties and verification components with prerequisites are waiting, and otherwise complete supported leaf or construction duties are ready; none of these values is a truth, proof, discharge, success, failure, or authority verdict.

Unknown, future, malformed, or structurally inapplicable statement and goal shapes remain explicit unsupported obligations rather than being omitted, guessed, repaired, rewritten, treated as false, or converted to successful empty graphs.

All strings are NUL-free NFC, integers exclude bool and remain within the portable exact range, arrays and graphs remain within fixed ceilings, duplicate JSON keys and floats fail, and subclasses, object.__new__, setattr, replace, copy, deepcopy, pickle, noncanonical encodings, and cycles cannot forge decomposed state.
